title: pmic frozen crystal replicates on seed 3 at F=0.01: micelles divide (29 persistent splits, gen 4) then pack into a static hexagonal crystal of ~114 bodies by t~800
summary: Fresh seed 3 of the finding's world at its default feed F=0.01, t=1000 (the world reads no WORLD_P, so I could not re-run the F=0.005/0.003 or yield arms). From white noise ~60 micelles form by t=40, divide (labkit 185 splits, 29 persistent, generation 4, merge/split 0.46 as touching bodies are merged by the tracker) and fill the box until, by t~800, they sit in a frozen hexagonal crystal of ~114 touching micelles with no further births or deaths (F001/sheet.png).

observations.F: F001/sheet.png t=600-1000: static hexagonal crystal; F001/FACTS.md 114 components, 29 persistent splits

controls_run.F: none of my own beyond the default arm; the feed scan and yield arms are the author's

verdicts.limitation: Only the F=0.01 arm re-run, to t=1000 rather than 2000. The zero-death, unmoved-yield results at lower feed are not checked by me.
